title.narrative: Support to financial investigations units in the Caribbean

description.narrative: This activity Support to financial investigations units in the Caribbean is a component of Caribbean Criminal Assets Recovery Programme reported by FCDO with a funding type of 112 - Other bilateral donor and a budget of £489,428. This project benefits Caribbean, regional. It works in the following sector(s): Anti-corruption organisations and institutions, Security system management and reform.
